whatIsText: This tool uses AI to turn your photo into a 3D figurine style image. Pick a style — chibi, realistic, pixel, or cyberpunk — and see how you'd look as a collectible figure. It's a fun way to visualize yourself in a new format.
faq1a: Yes. It runs on Cloudflare Workers AI with a free daily quota. Normal use won't hit limits.
faq2a: No. Your photo is processed in memory and discarded immediately after the result is generated. Nothing is stored.
faq3q: What kind of photo works best?
faq3a: Front-facing portraits with clear lighting and a plain background work best. Avoid blurry, low-light, or heavily filtered images.
faq4a: The AI model has a content filter that occasionally misidentifies harmless images. If generation fails, try a different photo with a simpler background.
faq5q: Can I use the result commercially?
faq5a: Yes. The tool doesn't add watermarks. You own the result, but make sure you have the rights to the original photo.
disclaimer: Note: AI-generated images are for entertainment. Do not use them for official identification or commercial licensing without review.
